changes.comment: PR #455 review round: deleted dead surface with zero producers. TurnManagerOptions.turnCwd/onTurnCompleted and args.ts's parseCodexArgs had no caller (the sole `new TurnManager` never supplied the first two, and codexArgsFromConfig replaced parseCodexArgs's only caller in an earlier stage); the output-schema codec's fingerprint field/hash was computed on every compile and never read. Also dropped the codex-home doctor context's dispatcherCwd/codexCliArgs params (never read by validation; the sole caller always supplies env directly), activity/path.ts's resolveCodexRolloutRoots env default (its one caller always passes env), and supervisor.ts's binPath fallback (redundant with bin.ts's resolveCodexBinPath, which the sole caller already resolves through). events.ts's submitTurnStart lost its cwd parameter too: with turnCwd gone, the sole caller always passed null, so the request never carried a cwd override. No runtime or published-API behavior change.
